pages.text:
The Mortar's bigger brother: crushes first, falls back to milling.

Uses its own windup and cycle timings — independent from the Mortar's config.

pages.title: Recipes it can do
pages.text:
$(li)Create's $(l)crushing$() recipes (first)$(br)$(li)Create's $(l)milling$() recipes (fallback)$(br)$(li)Exclusive recipes written for $(o)either$() mortar or crusher mortar$(br)
$(italic)Being an upgraded Mortar is intentional.$()

pages.title: Tips
pages.text: $(li)It accepts exclusive recipes whose $(l)tool$() field is $(c)mortar$() as well — you don't need to duplicate them.$(br)$(li)Filtering follows $(c)crusher_mortar$() table, even for recipes owned by $(c)mortar$().
